business_summary: Era Co., Ltd. engages in plastic pipe and solar energy businesses in China. The company offers polyvinyl chloride, polyethylene, and random copolymer polypropylene, as well as various pipe fittings and valves, which are used in municipal pipeline network, whole-house decoration, industrial pipeline network, construction engineering, fire protection, power communication, whole house decoration, agricultural breeding, and gas pipeline network. It is also involved in the research and development, production, and sale of solar photovoltaic modules, and energy-saving and environmental protection products. In addition, the company offers solar photovoltaic components, photovoltaic power generation systems, and photovoltaic building integration; and energy-saving and environmental protection products, such as solar lamps, low-voltage lamps, new energy storage, and other application products used in photovoltaic power generation, garden beautification, smart home, road traffic, outdoor camping, mobile energy storage, and others applications. It sells its energy products to photovoltaic power plant system integrators, traders, supermarkets, e-commerce, and end customers. The company was formerly known as Yonggao Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Era Co., Ltd. Era Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
